sloka: बाहुभ्यां वानरान् सर्वान् प्रगृह्य सुमहाबलः।भक्षयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो गरुडः पन्नगानिव ।। ६.६७.३५ ।।
transliteration: bāhubhyāṁ vānarān sarvān pragṛhya sumahābalaḥ।bhakṣayāmāsa saṅkruddho garuḍaḥ pannagāniva ।। 6.67.35 ।।

translations.english: The bulls among Vanaras hurt Kumbhakarna, endowed with strong shoulders, by scratching with nails, biting with teeth and hitting him with arms and fists.
